name: DaFont · Nahla Script Font

description.zh: 把这款字体的字形看清，再回详情读作者条件。 提供按主题、作者和排行浏览的字体档案，条目内有字样预览、字体文件下载和作者说明。各字体的价格与授权独立，本次核验的Nahla Script演示版仅供个人与非营利用途，商业使用需另购许可。
description.en: A font archive organized by themes, authors and rankings, with type previews, font downloads and author notes. Prices and permissions vary by font. The verified Nahla Script demo is limited to personal, nonprofit use; commercial use requires a separate license purchase.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by DaFont (https://www.dafont.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 把这款字体的字形看清，再回详情读作者条件。

Visual details from source observation: 我们在首页先看到主题目录和安装说明，下面就是字体自己的字样。建议先开Top，对照粗圆、像素和无衬线字样的差别，再进Nahla Script详情看字形表和作者说明，适合挑字体、做排版备选。下载按钮旁的标签只是一层提示，仍要读包内说明或作者网站；这次Nahla的演示版限个人与非营利用途，商用需另购许可。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
